blocks.text: 2 Chronicles 36 contains 23 verses. It opens with: Then the people of the land took Jehoahaz the son of Josiah, and made him king in his father's stead in Jerusalem. It concludes with: Thus saith Cyrus king of Persia, All the kingdoms of the earth hath Jehovah, the God of heaven, given me; and he hath charged me to build him a house in Jerusalem, which is in Judah. Whosoever there is among you of all his people, Jehovah his God be with him, and let him go up.
